baoyu-wechat-summary 1.117.4

- Added per-group fact memory (memory.md) support for richer fact continuity across runs.
- New EXTEND.md preference key: `bot_aliases` to configure names for triggering the 「@bot 答疑」 Q&A section, with customizable comma-separated values.
- Updated documentation to reflect the above enhancements.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.
- No breaking changes to workflow or major interfaces.
